Yes. The server may accept a request even when the client receives no response. Repeating the user's single send must not create a duplicate logical message.
Yes. Events may arrive late or more than once, including after the user opens another conversation. Applying one twice or rendering it in the wrong conversation is invalid.
No. The local connection can close while generation is still running, and a Stop response can be lost. The UI must not report an unconfirmed terminal outcome.
